subject: geom_boxplot with log scale and zero values

messages.author: a8e56938c8bd9e88
messages.subject: geom_boxplot with log scale and zero values
parts:
Dear all,

I am trying to make a box plot with log scale and zero values. The following simple
code snippet illustrates my problem:
  y <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 0, 4, 3, 2, 2, 3, 0)
  y <- as.data.frame(y)
  ggplot(y) + aes(y=y) + geom_boxplot() + coord_trans(y="log10", limy=c(1,10))

This does not work because of the zero values. But why? I thought the coord_trans()
function would not depend on the data set.

Best regards
Donatella
